name: Veil Masquerade #01
description: A cloth figure for Veil: a crowned mask over layered, patterned cloth falling to an uneven hem. Crown: Plume. Aperture: Twin slits. Ornament: Chevrons. Palette: Lilac. Hem: Beaded fringe. Its hem is shared with 2 others in the set of 20. No face — where the cloth is open, it is cloth removed rather than features drawn on.
